zone_name: Agro-Climatic Zone I / North-West Alluvial Plain (उत्तर-पश्चिमी जलोढ़ मैदान)

climate_rainfall_and_soil.summary: 1040 mm se 1450 mm varshik baarish, jahan lime-rich Bal-Sundari, Terai aur Khadar mitti milti hai.
climate_rainfall_and_soil.explanation: Zone I Ganga nadi ke theek uttar aur Gandak-Burhi Gandak basin mein phaila hua hai. Yahan ka mausam sub-tropical humid rehta hai, jismein garmiyon mein taapman 35°C se 40°C aur sardi mein 8°C se 10°C tak chala jata hai. Saalana baarish lagbhag 1040 mm se lekar 1450 mm tak hoti hai, jismein West Champaran ki taraf Terai ke paas baarish zyada hoti hai aur Saran-Siwan ki taraf aate-aate thodi ghat jati hai. Is zone ki mitti ka sabse bada lakshan hai 'Bal-Sundari' mitti, jismein chuna (calcium carbonate) 25-30% tak milta hai aur nature alkaline (pH 7.5 to 8.5) hota hai. Nadiyon ke kinare taaza Khadar mitti aur bilkul uttar mein Someshwar ke paas daldali Piedmont Swamp mitti milti hai.

cropping_profile_and_economy.explanation: Yeh zone Bihar ka sabse bada cash crop aur horticulture engine hai. Pure state ka 80% se zyada ganna (sugarcane) akele isi zone ke West Champaran aur Gopalganj belt mein paida hota hai, jiske dam par Bihar ki lagbhag saari operational sugar mills chalti hain. Muzaffarpur aur Vaishali ki world-famous GI-tagged Shahi Litchi aur Hajipur ka Chiniya kela isi chunedaar bal-sundari mitti ki den hain. Samastipur aur Begusarai mein Rabi makka ka itna tagda yield nikalta hai jo desh mein record banata hai. Iske alawa tambaku, sabziyan aur Mircha rice ka commercial production is zone ko agricultural wealth mein sabse uncha darja deta hai.

challenges_and_development.regional_bottlenecks: Gandak-Burhi Gandak aur Bagmati ki achanak baadh, chune ki wajah se zinc-iron deficiency, waterlogging (Chaur area)
challenges_and_development.explanation: Zone I ke kisanon ke samne sabse badi chunauti Gandak, Bagmati aur Kamla nadiyon se aane wali seasonal baadh aur 'Chaur' (low-lying wetlands) mein mahino tak paani jama rehna hai. Bal-sundari mitti mein chuna zyada hone ke karan paudhon mein zinc aur iron ka poshan nahi mil pata, jisse faslein peeli padne lagti hain. Isko theek karne ke liye Samastipur mein sthit Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU, Pusa) kisanon ko zinc sulphate aur micro-nutrient management ke packages deti hai. 4th Krishi Roadmap ke tahat Chaur vikas model (jahan paani mein machhli aur upar bagwani) ko promote kiya ja raha hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Zone I mein kul 13 ziley aate hain (Tirhut, Saran aur Darbhanga division ke mukhya ziley).
North-East ki tulna mein yahan thodi kam baarish hoti hai par West Champaran border par rainfall 1400 mm+ chali jati hai.
Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU) Pusa, Samastipur aur NRCL Mushahari (Muzaffarpur).
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ke Agro-Climatic Zone I (North-West) mein kul kitne ziley shamil hain?' Answer: 13 Ziley.

zone_name: Agro-Climatic Zone II / North-East Alluvial Plain (उत्तर-पूर्वी जलोढ़ मैदान)

climate_rainfall_and_soil.summary: 1200 mm se 1700 mm (highest) varshik baarish, jahan tezi se recharge hone wali Khadar aur acidic Terai mitti milti hai.
climate_rainfall_and_soil.explanation: Zone II Kosi aur Mahananda nadiyon ke catchment mein sthit Bihar ka sabse geela aur green hissa hai. Yahan monsoon sabse pehle dastak deta hai, isliye saalana baarish pure state mein sabse zyada (1200 mm se lekar Kishanganj mein 1700 mm tak) record hoti hai. Yahan ka mausam behad aadr (humid) rehta hai aur winter season lamba aur thanda hota hai. Mitti ke mamle mein yeh zone do hisson mein banta hai—Kishanganj aur Araria ke border par halki khatti (acidic, pH 5.0 to 6.0) Terai mitti milti hai, jabki Saharsa, Khagaria aur Purnea mein Kosi aur Ganga ki nayi silty-loam 'Khadar' mitti dominate karti hai, jiska nutrient level naturally har saal recharge hota hai.

cropping_profile_and_economy.explanation: Yeh zone commercial raw material aur superfood agriculture ka powerhouse hai. High rainfall aur humidity ke chalte Purnea, Katihar aur Kishanganj milkar Bihar ko desh mein Jute (Patson) ka 2nd largest producer banate hain. Kishanganj pure state ka ekmatra tea-growing hub hai aur pineapple ka single largest producer hai. Khagaria aur Saharsa ko high-yielding Rabi maize ke chalte 'Maize Bowl of Bihar' kaha jata hai, jahan Gulabbagh mandi Asia-level trade handle karti hai. Iske sath hi Katihar aur Purnea wetlands mein Mithila Makhana aur Naugachia belt mein G-9 Kela ki bumper commercial kheti kisanon ko high cash returns deti hai.

challenges_and_development.regional_bottlenecks: Kosi ki vinashkari baadh, sand-casting (khet mein ret jamna), soil acidity, high humidity se fungal rog
challenges_and_development.explanation: Zone II ka sabse bada dukh Kosi aur Mahananda nadiyon ki unpredictable baadh hai. Baadh ka paani na sirf khadi kharif fasal ko dooba deta hai, balki upjau khet par do-teen foot moti ret bicha deta hai (sand-casting), jisse zameen banjar lagne lagti hai. Kishanganj ki taraf tezz barish se poshak tatva beh jate hain aur mitti khatti ho jati hai. Bihar Sarkar ne Purnea mein Mega Jute Park aur grain-based ethanol plants lagaye hain taaki makka aur jute kisanon ko behtar daam milein. Mandan Bharti Agriculture College (Agwanpur, Saharsa) ke zariye sand-casting zameen par cucurbits aur boro rice lagane ki techniques train ki ja rahi hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Zone II mein kul 8 ziley shamil hain (Kosi aur Purnea division ke ziley plus Khagaria).
Pure Bihar mein sabse zyada ausat varshik baarish isi zone (Kishanganj district highest in Bihar) mein hoti hai.
Kishanganj Agriculture College, Purnea Regional Research Station, aur Mandan Bharti Agriculture College (Saharsa).
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ke kis agro-climatic zone mein sabse zyada varshik varsha (annual rainfall) hoti hai?' Answer: Zone II (North-East).

zone_name: Agro-Climatic Zone III / South Bihar Alluvial Plain (दक्षिणी बिहार जलोढ़ मैदान)
total_districts: 17 Districts (Zone IIIA: 6 Districts + Zone IIIB: 11 Districts)

climate_rainfall_and_soil.summary: 950 mm se 1150 mm (lowest) varshik baarish, jahan bhari Karail-Kewal, Tal mitti aur pathari margin par Balthar mitti milti hai.
climate_rainfall_and_soil.explanation: Zone III Ganga nadi ke theek dakshin mein Son, Punpun, Falgu aur Kiul nadiyon ke basin se lekar Chota Nagpur plateau ke border tak phaila hua hai. Bihar ke teeno zones mein yeh sabse kam baarish (950 mm se 1150 mm) paane wala aur sabse dry zone hai, jahan summer mein taapman 42°C se 45°C tak chala jata hai. Is ilaqe ki main mitti 'Karail-Kewal' hai—jo kaale-peele rang ki behad bhari chikni mitti hoti hai, jismein paani rokne ki takat sabse zyada hoti hai par sookhne par deep cracks pad jate hain. Fatuha se Lakhisarai tak Ganga ke south bank par 'Tal Mitti' milti hai, aur Kaimur se Banka border par kankareeli 'Balthar' (red-yellow) mitti aati hai.

cropping_profile_and_economy.explanation: Yeh zone Bihar ka undisputed 'Rice-Wheat and Pulse Bowl' hai. Sone Nahar (Canal) system ke synchronization ke chalte Rohtas aur Kaimur pure state mein paddy aur wheat dono ke production aur yield mein Rank 1 par rehte hain, jisse Rohtas ko 'Granary of Bihar' kaha jata hai. Mokama aur Barahiya ka Tal area pure desh mein Rabi pulses (khaas kar Masoor aur Chana) ke bumper production ke liye jana jata hai. Nalanda aur Patna vegetable production (aalu, pyaaz) mein lead karte hain, jabki Bhagalpur ka Zardalu aam aur Katarni chawal, aur Nawada ka Magahi paan GI-tagged shaan hain.

challenges_and_development.regional_bottlenecks: Dry spells aur sukha (drought), canal tail-end water shortage, Tal area mein delayed water drainage, hard clay jutai dikkat
challenges_and_development.explanation: Zone III ke kisanon ke samne sabse badi samasya kam baarish aur groundwater depletion hai. Monsoon fail hote hi Gaya, Nawada aur Aurangabad mein khet sookhne lagte hain. Karail-kewal mitti ka nature aisa hota hai ki sookhne par patthar jaisi kadi ho jati hai, jisse buaai ke liye kisanon ke paas bohot kam samay bachta hai. Iske ilawa Tal kshetr mein paani der se utarne par rabi buaai mein deri hoti hai. Bihar Agricultural University (BAU, Sabour, Bhagalpur) yahan dryland farming aur dhaan ki DSR (Direct Seeded Rice) technique promote kar rahi hai. Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali ke tehat Ahar-Pyne system ka punaruddhar kiya ja raha hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Zone III mein kul 17 ziley aate hain; administrative purposes ke liye isko do sub-zones mein banta jata hai: IIIA (South-East - 6 ziley) aur IIIB (South-West - 11 ziley).
Bihar ka sabse kam baarish paane wala agro-climatic zone (Arwal, Aurangabad aur Gaya mein sub-1000 mm rainfall).
Bihar Agricultural University (BAU) Sabour, Bhagalpur jo pure South Bihar ke agricultural research ko lead karti hai.
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ke kis agro-climatic zone mein sabse zyada ziley shamil hain?' Answer: Zone III (Dakshin Bihar - 17 Ziley).
